description: This file provides a service for managing the best score in an asteroid dodging game, primarily using localStorage for persistence. It offers functions to load, save, and update the best score, with a focus on in-memory fallback if localStorage is unavailable.

methods.name: loadLocalBestScore()
methods.description: Load best score from localStorage. Returns a number >= 0; if not found or in case of error, returns 0.

methods.name: saveLocalBestScore(score)
methods.description: Save best score to localStorage, ensuring it's a non-negative integer. Returns the saved value.

methods.name: updateLocalBestIfNeeded(currentScore)
methods.description: Compare current score to stored best score; update storage if current is greater. Returns an object with the best score and a flag indicating if it was updated.
